searches_tried: pipeline comps.py: 'rabbit trap' (many Armitage/Gowans hits), 'Lane's Ezy-Set trap' (none), 'Cyclone trap' (unrelated watch), 'antique steel trap jaw' (none), 'vintage animal trap' (none); work comps.py: 'rabbit trap', 'steel jaw trap'. No resale comps (eBay, other auction houses) in databases. Local hits show roughly $10 to $15 per trap, so six traps in this condition about $60 to $90 locally.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'vintage rabbit trap' and 'Lane's Ezy-Set rabbit trap', 'Cyclone rabbit trap', 'antique gin trap lot' (Sold filter, Australia). Terapeak on 'rabbit trap'. Also Gumtree/Facebook Marketplace ask prices for 'vintage rabbit traps' and Carter's / Theodore Bruce 'rabbit traps' results. Check for named makers (Lane, Cyclone, Sargent, Oneida Newhouse, Victor) which sell higher singly.
viewing_check: Turn each trap over and check the pan, springs and jaws for a stamped maker name or patent mark (Lane's Ezy-Set, Cyclone, Sargent, Hawkins, Oneida); only a named maker or an unusual type (man trap, mole or fox size) adds value. Otherwise commonplace.
